groups.sourceText:
During the Anhui inspection,Xi also
emphasized the need to strengthen the
protection of historical and cultural
heritage,as well as the promotion of
creative transformation and innovative
development of fine traditional culture.
groups.translatedText: 在安徽考察期间，习近平还强调要加强历史文化遗产保护，推动中华优秀传统文化创造性转化、创新性发展。

groups.sourceText:
Tongcheng has woven the values
associated with the alley into community
work and grassroots governance,using
persuasion,empathy and compromise to
help resolve disputes before they escalate.
groups.translatedText: 桐城将小巷所蕴含的价值融入社区工作和基层治理中，运用说服、共情和妥协等方式帮助化解矛盾于萌芽状态。

groups.sourceText:
That emphasis on accommodation,Zhang
stressed,does not mean asking people to
yield without principle."It's not simply
giving way,still less forcing someone to do
so,"he said."It is a gesture the stronger
side takes the first step,while morality and
law work together.
groups.translatedText: 张强强调，这种对包容的强调并不意味着要求人们无原则退让。“这不仅仅是让步，更不是强迫别人这样做，”他说，“这是强势一方主动迈出的一步，同时道德与法律共同发挥作用。”

groups.sourceText:
The approach is also gaining broader
institutional backing.On July 24,the
Standing Committee of the Anhui
Provincial People's Congress adopted
groups.translatedText: 这一做法也获得了更广泛的制度支持。7月24日，安徽省人大常委会通过
